title: One-Hour Luxury City Tour of Victoria
includes: Cruise Port Passenger Pick up Fee is not included. (Please inquire)
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
policies: This tour can accommodate space for a collapsed wheel chair, providing the guest is able to get into the car with minimal assistance
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Visit Victoria's major highlights in the comfort of a full-size, luxury SUV on a 1-hour sightseeing trip. This tour is perfect for guests who are on a tight schedule, with a small budget, and need a flexible start time. The tour is fully narrated with historical facts, currents statistics, and a few spooky ghost stories, too. Make plenty of stops for photo opportunities on this brief but thorough adventure. Local hotel pickup and drop-off included.
